```sh
kafka topic producers <topic>
```

Show a topic's active producer state, per partition

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `topic`  | topic name  |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

With no partition filter, queries every partition of the topic.

## Flags

| Flag                                | Description                                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--brokers <string>`                | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                   |
| `--partition <number> (repeatable)` | partition index to query (repeatable; defaults to every partition) |
| `--broker-id <string>`              | query a specific replica broker instead of the partition leaders   |

## Examples

```sh
kafka topic producers orders --brokers localhost:9092
kafka topic producers orders --partition 0 --partition 1 --brokers localhost:9092
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "partitions": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `6`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
